defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into any predictable raid hit; it costs no global and works in Cat Form, so it never interrupts your rotation.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the hits you cannot avoid, and pair it with Barkskin when a mechanic would otherwise kill you.

defensives.name: Frenzied Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Shift to Bear Form and press it after you have already taken the damage, then shift straight back to Cat Form.

defensives.name: Renewal
defensives.usage_rule: Press it for an instant chunk of health without leaving Cat Form or dropping a global on Regrowth.
